blocks.text: Christmas came to life at Jpark Island Resort and Waterpark in Mactan on November 11, 2026, as the resort welcomed the holiday season with the lighting of three towering Christmas trees at its entrance and the unveiling of a life-sized gingerbread house. The celebration brought together familiar holiday sights, festive displays, and seasonal treats, setting the mood for the weeks leading up to Christmas. Christmas Comes Home to JPark The ceremony was led by Jpark CEO Jason Uy, alongside Corporate Secretary Jerry Uy and Vice President for Operations and General Manager Anders Hallden.
